error[MBS-E23]: this `when` condition can't be decided when mbsc runs
  --> e23_when_condition.mbs:26:7
   |
26 |     when draw.alpha_cutoff > 0.5 {
   |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ not a test of `TARGET`
   |
   = note: a `when` is settled before the shader is compiled, so it can only use `TARGET`, `==`, `!=`, `&&`, `||` and `!`
   = help: write `when TARGET == .PICA200 { ... }`
